STYLE: Stop-motion clay puppet scene - clay characters detailed with tiny craft materials: thread-wrapped hair, fabric details, wire accents, on a fully sculpted clay set, cinematic stop-motion film lighting with gentle shadows, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the puppet world. Palette: warm cream, terracotta and mustard clay with deep teal shadows, warm amber light; one bright subject against a calm, plain clay wall.

FORMAT AND LAYOUT: one vertical 9:16 image (portrait, 9 wide by 16 tall). Positions are fractions of the frame from the top-left corner. The top 30% of the frame is only plain clay wall, empty, kept clear for words added later. The main subject sits between 30% and 80% down. Nothing important in the bottom 20% of the frame, and nothing but the empty page's bare squares in the right 13%.

REFERENCE MAP: no reference images are attached; everything comes from this text.

SUBJECT, THE WALL CALENDAR: one clay wall calendar hangs flat on the wall, facing the camera straight on, centred, spanning from 8% to 92% of the frame width and from 34% to 80% of the frame height. It is open to two month pages side by side, each sculpted from flat cream clay with a stitched fabric border and a stitched grid of empty day squares, joined by a stitched seam down the middle. A small clay ledge runs along the bottom of each row of squares.
THE LEFT PAGE (8% to 50% across) is full: about twelve little clay client figures, each about the height of a thumb, stand on its ledges, filling the page. They are simple adult business people in tiny fabric jackets and trousers, thread-wrapped hair, simple eyes with white sclera and dark pupils, mixed skin tones, standing and chatting, calm and pleased. Their feet touch the ledges.
THE RIGHT PAGE (50% to 92% across) is completely bare: empty stitched squares and empty ledges, nobody and nothing on it.

HANDS: no human hands, fingers or arms anywhere in the picture.

TEXT: none. No text, letters, numbers or words anywhere in the picture: not on the calendar, the wall or any object. The calendar's day squares are empty stitched squares with no numbers, and there is no month name.

SETTING: one plain warm cream clay wall fills the background edge to edge, softly lit by warm amber light from the upper left, a gentle deep teal shadow at the bottom. No window, shelf, desk or other objects. Camera at eye level, facing the calendar straight on. Medium close-up.

CAMERA: macro miniature-set look, about 50mm, shallow depth of field, the main subject sharp; the camera sits inside the miniature clay world.

CONTINUITY: this is the first shot, no previous shot to match; carry over the series look: claymation in the song's cloth world (fabric and thread details on clay).

DO NOT INCLUDE: no text, letters, numbers or words; no hearts, likes, thumbs-up, follower counts, notification badges, social media icons or logos; no real platform names, logos or app screens; no phone screens; no extra subjects beyond those named; no clutter in the top third; no smooth, glossy or CGI-looking surfaces; no motion blur; no border or frame around the whole picture, no split-screen layout, no set edges, workbench or the room around the miniature set (the calendar's own stitched fabric border and its two side-by-side pages are wanted); no figure, object or mark on the right page; no more than two calendar pages.

Everything in frame is real modeling clay, photographed - visible fingerprints and tool marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
